note: vespera!: schemas nested in a cfg(test) fn / impl / trait / const / static body or emitted by a cfg(test) item or statement macro (schema_type!) are left out of openapi.json in every build; route and cron modules or handlers named gen are emitted as r#gen (edition 2024); request views that differ only through #[form_data(default)] or a one-sided Serialize_repr / Deserialize_repr derive get their {Name}Input component; handlers marked #[deprecated] are mounted without a deprecation warning; the internally tagged non-object check also covers generic instances and inline path schemas; the schema cache hashes source identity, rust ident and explicit name; merging invocations in different files get distinct cache tags; cron discovery scans the crate root rustc is compiling first and resolves #[path] inline modules like rustc; export_app!(prefix = "/api/_") namespaces as Api; invalid VESPERA_DOCS_URL / VESPERA_REDOC_URL / VESPERA_SPEC_URL errors name the variable.
